scenarios.prompt: Locate the adapter registration path and validate the plugin entry. You only have a tight step budget, so broad repo scans and broad test sweeps are risky.

toolset.name: grep
toolset.description: Broad recursive search across the repo when the target file is unknown.

toolset.name: rg
toolset.description: Focused ripgrep search when you have a likely file target or want a narrower search path.

toolset.name: node-test-broad
toolset.description: Run the broad Node test sweep for the package.

toolset.name: node-test-focused
toolset.description: Run the focused plugin entry test once the target path is known.

aionis.context_text: Under a tight budget, use the focused path only: rg on src/plugin.ts, then node-test-focused on test/plugin-entry.test.mjs, then finish.
